meta.reason: D-1253: lake ids are per patient. Every id of a patient's record holds the patient, so every id column and every id-derived value moves once (proved by tools/goldens_id_proof.py: one one-to-one id map per data set makes every row, funnel, candidate list and outcome equal). The -deletes set's next night now chooses records by content, not by their place in the id-sorted snapshot (tools/golden_nights.py). New set ssmix2-jp-per-patient: numbers repeat across patients.

ssmix2-jp-per-patient.kind: SS-MIX2 storage, numbers repeating across patients
